火种（火种（第22页）“另外，你们能在此地停留的时间是有限的，且最好抓紧在接下来的五天内突破神变之境。”苍鸿突然将目光放在了千山界中央的那座屏障，道：“五天后神子大会便会开启，若你们能在那之前突破神变，便可前往千山秘境内参加神子大会了。”他说着，看了楚修一眼，道：“天资不错者若能在神子大会上取得不错的名次，便有机会能加入三流、二流乃至顶流世家。”“净土大世与你们的雾府有些不同，在这里，不加入世家便无法得到真意法，也就无法向上攀登。”沈长青等人将这些事情牢牢记下。这时，一旁的三位苍氏年轻人突然呵呵笑了起来：“一辈子的底层人咯。”望见沈长青一行不太好看的脸色，三位苍氏年轻人依旧在笑，“你们还别不服气，在雾府我们不说什么，但到了这里，你们很快就会知道什么才叫一粒蜉蝣望青天。”这三人好似有种天生的优越感，眼神得意又自豪。苍鸿对此仿佛置若罔闻，在与沈长青一行人简单交待完成之后，便是带着苍氏三位年轻人消失在了原地。“也不知道这苍氏一族究竟是何种级别的世家，竟如此……”宋子川欲言又止。沈长青摇摇头，转身向着身后的府邸走去，打开大门之后，一片绿意盎然的世界顿时出现在眼前。浓郁的灵气扑面而来，别的不说，净土的基础条件确实比雾府要强大太多了。光是这府邸内的灵气就远远不是东漓学宫能比的。“人人皆可修行的世界，当真是没有虚言。”李彦君夫妇显然并没有被苍氏三人的话影响，他们感受着这浓郁的灵气，只觉得干涸多年的丹田好似要重新苏醒过来。“这些净土出身的人当真好命。”唐梦蝶言语中充满羡慕，“若我也能出身于净土，如今定然也是神变境修士。”众人走进府邸之中，这座府邸极大，房间足有四五十个，哪怕每个人一个房间都已是完全足够。不过修炼室只有十个，对应着原本的十位神子。将李彦君夫妇、江伯父子等人安顿好之后，沈长青三人便各自走进了修炼室。这修炼室有阵法加持，突破时不会被其他人打扰，产生的动静也会大大减小。来到修炼室，这里的灵气更加浓郁。只不过沈长青暂时没有修炼的心思，他将令牌激活，一枚豆大的火种便缓缓出现在了眼前。“这便是能提升两成突破神变几率的净世奇物吗？”沈长青将火种拿在手中仔细端详，没有发现什么异常之后便走出了修炼室。不多时，他便来到了另一间修炼室内。李沐颜就在这里，而且其之前方，同样有一枚火种。“娘子，加油。”沈长青将自己的火种递了过去。“两件净世奇物，现在的我，突破的几率已经来到七成。”李沐颜脸上有些紧张，但更多的还是期待，“夫君，谢谢你，我会努力的！”沈长青也不再耽误自己娘子，告别之后，便走出了静室。此时楚修也待在修炼室中准备突破。趁着这个时间，他要去千山城补充一下净土的诸多知识，顺便在打听一下赚钱的门道……

Fire (Page 22) "In addition, the time you can stay here is limited, and it is best to break through the realm of divine transformation within the next five days." Cang Hong suddenly focused on the barrier in the center of the Qianshan Realm and said: "The God Son Conference will start in five days. If you can break through the divine transformation before then, you can go to the Qianshan Secret Territory to participate in the God Son Conference." He said, glanced at Chu Xiu, and said: "Those with good talents will If you can get a good ranking in the Son of God Conference, you will have the opportunity to join a third-rate, second-rate or even a top-level family. "The Pure Land is a little different from your Wu Mansion. Here, you can't get the true meaning without joining the family, and you can't climb up." Shen Changqing and others kept these things in mind. At this time, the three young people of the Cang family suddenly laughed: "It's not a good look to be a lifelong low-level person." With expressions on their faces, the three young people from the Cang clan were still smiling, "Don't be dissatisfied. We don't say anything in Wu Mansion, but when you get here, you will soon know what it means to look at the sky like a mayfly." These three people seemed to have a natural sense of superiority, and their eyes were smug and proud. Cang Hong seemed to turn a deaf ear to this, and after a brief explanation with Shen Changqing and his party, he disappeared with the three young people from the Cang clan. "I don't know that this Cang clan. What kind of aristocratic family is this..." Song Zichuan hesitated. Shen Changqing shook his head, turned and walked towards the mansion behind him. After opening the door, a green world suddenly appeared in front of him. Rich spiritual energy rushed towards his face. Not to mention anything else, the basic conditions of Pure Land are indeed much stronger than Wu Mansion. The spiritual energy in this mansion alone is far beyond that of Dongli Academy. "A world where everyone can practice, seriously. It's not false." Li Yanjun and his wife were obviously not affected by the words of the Cang family. They felt the strong spiritual energy and felt that their Dantian, which had been dry for many years, seemed to be reawakening. "These people who were born in the Pure Land are really lucky." Tang Mengdie said with envy, "If I could also be born in the Pure Land, I would definitely be a cultivator of the Divine Transformation Realm now." Everyone walked into the mansion. This mansion was huge, even if there were forty or fifty rooms each. One room is enough for one person. However, there are only ten training rooms, corresponding to the original ten divine sons. After settling Li Yanjun and his wife, Mr. Jiang and his son, Shen Changqing walked into the training room separately. This training room was blessed by other people, and the noise generated would be greatly reduced. When he came to the training room, the spiritual energy here was even stronger. However, Shen Changqing had no intention of practicing for the time being. Then, a bean-sized fire slowly appeared in front of him. "Is this a magical item that can increase the chance of breaking through the divine transformation by 20%?" Shen Changqing took the fire in his hand and looked at it carefully. After not finding anything unusual, he walked out of the training room. Li Muyan was here, and there was also a fire in front of him. "Madam, come on." Shen Changqing handed over his fire. With these two rare artifacts, I have a 70% chance of breakthrough." Li Muyan's face was a little nervous, but she was more hopeful, "Husband, thank you, I will work hard!" Shen Changqing no longer delayed his wife, and walked out of the quiet room after saying goodbye. At this time, Chu Xiu also stayed in the training room to prepare for a breakthrough. Taking advantage of this time, he would go to Qianshan City to supplement his knowledge of the Pure Land, and also inquire about ways to make money...
